description: utilpeek: Spellcheck a text with suggestions. For counts and readability use text_stats. Returns the words not in the language's word-frequency dictionary (pyspellchecker), with positions (offset, line, column) and up to `max_suggestions` suggestions by edit distance; numbers, acronyms, CamelCase, URLs and emails are skipped. A dictionary lookup, not grammar or context aware. Typically under 1 s (up to 2 s on a language's first use). Price: USD 0.002. Free: 10 utilpeek calls per IP per UTC day. The submitted text is never logged or stored. Docs: https://tanod.dev/learn/spell-check-api.html

language.description: Dictionary: en (default), es, fr, de or pt.
language.title: Language

max_suggestions.description: Corrections suggested per misspelled word (0-10, default 5).
max_suggestions.title: Max Suggestions

name: text_spellcheck

error.description: Only on an error result: an object {code, message}, or the reason string of an x402 PaymentRequired object.
